title: Drift Review Result Attestation
description: Minimal descriptive record for a completed human-reviewed drift-review outcome.

attestation_type.description: The only review-result attestation type supported by this contract.

schema_version.description: Attestation schema version supported by the lightweight validator.

source_task_type.description: Task-envelope type that produced the reviewed outcome.

classification.description: Human-reviewed outcome classification, recorded descriptively rather than inferred.

cleanup_required.description: Whether the completed review determined that cleanup work remains.

reviewer_type.description: Descriptive reviewer source, such as human or human_assisted.

evidence_summary.description: Concise reviewed evidence or notes supporting the recorded classification.
